items.title: Major pizza chain franchisee closes stores, no bankruptcy filed
items.summary: The pizza restaurant franchisee at one time owned over two dozen locations.

items.title: 3 Stocks Under $50 We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: The $10-50 price range often includes mid-sized businesses with proven track records and plenty of growth runway ahead. They also usually carry less risk than penny stocks, though they’re not immune to volatility as many lack the scale advantages of their larger peers.

items.title: Mexican Food is Popular in the UAE, But Taco Bell May Face Challenges With Its Re-Entry
items.summary: Americana Restaurants International will bring Taco Bell to the United Arab Emirates and other Gulf Cooperation Council for the first time since the restaurant chain left in 2012.

items.title: CDC Declares Cyclospora Outbreak Linked to Iceberg Lettuce as Over
items.summary: The outbreak, which federal health officials linked to shredded iceberg lettuce from supplier Taylor Farms, resulted in a total of 12,883 reported cases of the gastrointestinal food-borne illness across 21 states.

items.title: YUM, WMT Stocks In Focus: CDC Declares Cyclospora Outbreak Over After Nearly 13,000 Cases
items.summary: The outbreak, which was due to contaminated lettuce, resulted in 570 hospitalizations and two deaths across 21 states.

items.title: Cracker Barrel Stock Doubled This Year. It’s Time to Ask For the Check.
items.summary: The company’s customer base is rapidly growing too old to go on road trips, which is probably a big reason sales have fallen over the past four years.

items.title: CMG Margins Under Pressure: Can Pricing Offset Rising Costs?
items.summary: CMG's Q2 growth has come with margin pressure as inflation and higher costs outweigh pricing gains, putting productivity and easing inflation in focus.

items.title: How Is Yum! Brands' Stock Performance Compared to Other Consumer Cyclical Stocks?
items.summary: Although Yum! Brands has outperformed relative to its industry peers over the past year, Wall Street analysts maintain a cautiously optimistic outlook on the stock’s prospects.
